candidates.title: Swarm Telepathy: Prefill-Free KV-Cache Transfer Across Families
candidates.abstract: LLM multi-agent systems split work across agents that communicate through text. An agent summarizes its findings, another agent receives the text. This constrains communication to discrete tokens and costs redundant compute, limiting bandwidth and capabilities of multi-agent systems. Recent works demonstrate KV-cache transfer between LLMs but they either require the LLMs to be within the same family or cannot function across context, thus requiring the receiver to prefill text. We present SwaT (Swarm Telepathy), the first cross-family KV-cache transfer method that allows prefill-free communication in multi-family multi-agent systems. In an agent-to-agent communication setting, combining SwaT with recent advances in KV-cache compaction beats text-to-text communication in both accuracy and speed, with a mean of $40\%$ higher accuracy and a mean of $4\times$ faster wall-clock time. Experiments show SwaT achieves high performance on 17 benchmarks across 12 LLMs and 6 families. Additionally, given a sender Vision-Language Model (VLM), SwaT is able to transfer the vision capabilities to a text-only receiver LLM exceeding text-to-text communication despite SwaT being trained on text-only data. SwaT keeps both sender and receiver models frozen without fine-tuning and only requires $<50M$ tokens and $<1$ GPU-day to train.
candidates.reason: モデル系列をまたいでKVキャッシュを転送し受信側のprefillを不要にするSwaTによりマルチエージェント間のテキスト通信を置き換え、精度を上げつつ壁時計時間を平均で4倍高速化する直接のKV転送機構である。

candidates.title: Policy-Guided Stepwise Model Routing for Cost-Effective Reasoning
candidates.abstract: Inference-time computation has greatly enhanced the performance of large language models (LLMs) on challenging reasoning tasks, but this strategy can incur high inference costs. One solution is to route intermediate chain-of-thought (CoT) states to language models of different sizes; however, existing approaches rely on handcrafted routing strategies that limit performance, or on training large process reward models that may be infeasible in many applications. We formulate stepwise model routing as a constrained decision-making problem, which we solve by training a small control policy using reinforcement learning in conjunction with threshold calibration to tune the performance-efficiency tradeoff. We validate our method on three math benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH500, and OmniMath) on both open and closed models. Our method consistently improves the accuracy-cost tradeoff compared to handcrafted approaches, while achieving a comparable tradeoff to methods that require training large process reward models.
candidates.reason: 中間的な思考状態をサイズの異なる言語モデルへ段階的に振り分ける問題を制約付き意思決定として定式化し、小型制御ポリシーの強化学習と閾値較正で精度と推論費用のトレードオフを改善する。

candidates.title: Beyond Energy: When Sustainability Dimensions Reshape LLM Serving Decisions
candidates.abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving has environmental impacts across energy consumption, carbon emission, water consumption, and biodiversity loss. Yet these dimensions are largely evaluated in isolation, leaving it unclear when and how they lead to different optimization decisions. We present PRISM, a unified framework for characterizing and optimizing LLM serving across energy, carbon, water, and biodiversity impacts. Our analysis reveals a fundamental distinction: computing configurations determine energy consumption, whereas where and when LLM serving is deployed determine its carbon, water, and biodiversity impacts. Under a fixed deployment choice and operational-only accounting, all dimensions preserve the same energy-based configuration ranking. Deployment rankings can diverge across dimensions, while embodied impacts can break configuration invariance when they exceed a lifecycle crossover boundary. PRISM identifies these conditions, quantifies cross-dimensional regrets, and balances the four dimensions. In regional-routing experiments, PRISM reduces median worst-case regret by 50.2% relative to the strongest baseline.
candidates.reason: LLMサービングのエネルギーと炭素と水と生物多様性の影響を統一枠組みPRISMで特徴づけ、配置と構成で順位がどう変わるかを示し地域ルーティングで最悪ケース後悔を半減させるサービング最適化である。

candidates.title: SoftmAP: Software-Hardware Co-Design for Integer-Only Softmax on Associative Processors
candidates.venue: Design, Automation and Test in Europe
candidates.abstract: Recent research efforts focus on reducing the computational and memory overheads of Large Language Models (LLMs) to make them feasible on resource-constrained devices. Despite advancements in compression techniques, nonlinear operators like Softmax and Layernorm remain bottlenecks due to their sensitivity to quantization. We propose SoftmAP, a software-hardware co-design methodology that implements an integer-only low-precision Softmax using In-Memory Compute (IMC) hardware. Our method achieves up to three orders of magnitude improvement in the energy-delay product compared to A100 and RTX3090 GPUs, making LLMs more deployable without compromising performance.
candidates.reason: 量子化に敏感なSoftmaxを連想プロセッサ上のインメモリ計算で整数のみで実行するソフトウェアとハードウェアの協調設計であり、資源制約下のLLM推論における非線形演算のボトルネックを直接下げる。

candidates.title: Re-FORC: Adaptive Reward Prediction for Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
candidates.abstract: We propose Re-FORC, an adaptive reward prediction method that, given a query, enables prediction of the expected future rewards as a function of the number of future thinking tokens. Re-FORC trains a lightweight adapter on reasoning models, demonstrating improved prediction with longer reasoning and larger models. Re-FORC enables: 1) early stopping of unpromising reasoning chains, reducing compute by up to 26\% compared to fixed-budget cutoffs, while maintaining accuracy, 2) optimized model and thinking length selection that outperforms the largest model alone--- reaching 1.7 percentage points higher peak accuracy while needing up to 12\% less compute to match the largest model's accuracy, 3) adaptive test-time scaling, which increases accuracy by 9.9 percentage points (on average at maximum compute) over confidence-based baselines. Re-FORC allows dynamic reasoning with length control via cost-per-token thresholds while estimating computation time upfront.
candidates.reason: 将来報酬を思考トークン数の関数として予測する軽量アダプタにより有望でない推論チェーンの早期停止とモデルおよび思考長の選択を可能にし、精度を保ちながら推論計算を最大で削減する機構である。
